capabilities: Write JavaScript transform functions for matches
Apply replacements automatically on editor change
Manage rules through a settings UI
Use dynamic variables like the note title in patterns
extras: Includes a security warning that user-written JavaScript transform functions execute locally in the vault and should only be used if understood; full documentation is hosted externally via a link in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically rewrite matched text in notes based on custom rules while editing.
summary: Regex-rule text replacer that automatically applies regex patterns and JavaScript transform functions to note text as you type.
